pictures.name: cave_mouth_from_within
pictures.scene: the inside of a rock cave looking out toward a bright opening, the near floor lit warm and low where the daylight reaches it, the walls and roof above closing in dark and close and entirely bare

pictures.name: narrow_opening_to_the_sky
pictures.scene: a narrow slot in the rock high overhead letting one clean shaft of daylight down onto a stone floor, the lit ground warm and bright low in the frame, the walls between them black and sheer and silent

pictures.name: water_poured_out_on_the_ground
pictures.scene: a clay jar tipped right over with all its water running out across dry stone, the spreading wet lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the ground and shadow above it dull and brown and still

pictures.name: guttering_lamp_still_alight
pictures.scene: a small lamp burning very low with its wick almost spent but still holding a flame, the bowl and the bench lit faintly warm at the bottom of the frame, the room above it deep and cold and unlit

pictures.name: stony_path_between_rocks
pictures.scene: a narrow stony path threading between two shoulders of grey rock, its nearest stones lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the boulders above it standing close and dim and full of shadow

pictures.name: empty_ground_beside_a_worn_track
pictures.scene: a well worn track with nothing but bare trodden dust to one side of it, the near ground lit low and warm, the empty land beyond running out flat and pale to a horizon with nothing standing on it

pictures.name: bare_plain_with_no_shelter
pictures.scene: an enormous open plain of gravel and thin scrub with no rock or tree anywhere upon it, the near stones lit hard and low, the sky above it wide and bright and offering no cover of any kind

pictures.name: deep_rock_shelter_facing_the_sun
pictures.scene: a deep overhang of solid rock with its dry floor full of low warm sunlight, the lit ground gold at the bottom of the frame, the great mass of stone above it steady and dim and unbroken

pictures.name: low_hollow_in_the_ground
pictures.scene: a shallow hollow worn into bare earth with a little light just reaching its floor, the near rim lit warm and low, the ground rising away above it on every side dull and grey and featureless

pictures.name: dust_rising_on_the_far_track
pictures.scene: a long plume of dust lifting on a distant track across an open plain, the near grass lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the pale cloud and the sky beyond it flat and hazy and colourless

pictures.name: opened_door_of_a_stone_cell
pictures.scene: the heavy door of a small stone cell standing wide open with daylight flooding across the threshold, the lit floor warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the walls above it dim and rough and empty

pictures.name: ring_of_lamps_on_a_courtyard_floor
pictures.scene: a circle of small clay lamps set out burning together on a swept courtyard floor, their flames and the paving lit warm and gold low in the frame, the open air above them quiet and dark and calm

lines.text: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
I cry aloud to the LORD;
I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before Him;
I reveal my trouble to Him.
Although my spirit grows faint within me,
You know my way.
Along the path I travel
they have hidden a snare for me.
Look to my right and see;
no one attends to me.
There is no refuge for me;
no one cares for my soul.
I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge,
my portion in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry,
for I am brought quite low.
Rescue me from my pursuers,
for they are too strong for me.
Free my soul from prison,
that I may praise Your name.
The righteous will gather around me
because of Your goodness to me.
